welcome_text.default: Please insert yubikey and press enter or enter a valid passphrase
welcome_text.description: The text displayed to the user during the YubiKey authentication prompt.

concatenate.description: Set to 1 if you want both your password and Yubikey response to be bundled together and written to the key slot.

hash.description: Set to 1 if you want to hash your password with sha256.
